design_vision: Cinematic Dark Tech. A premium, futuristic AI agency website using pure black/near-black backgrounds, glowing periwinkle (#7B7FE8) accents, and sharp typography. Avoiding standard SaaS-slop by leaning into editorial asymmetry, high-contrast text, generous negative space, and high-fidelity 3D interactions.

typography.h1: text-5xl md:text-6xl lg:text-7xl tracking-tighter font-medium text-white
typography.h2: text-3xl md:text-4xl lg:text-5xl tracking-tight font-medium text-white
typography.instructions: Never use Inter or Roboto. Maintain strict left-alignment for dense content. Use tight line-heights for headings (leading-none or leading-tight). Ensure a maximum heading size of text-6xl/7xl for hero sections. Always ensure contrast ratios against dark backgrounds.

layout_and_spacing.instructions: Use generous padding. Avoid tight clustering. Wrap sections in dark atmospheric backgrounds without harsh linear gradients. Use 'glassmorphism' panels with high blur (backdrop-blur-2xl) and 1px borders.

motion_and_interactions.hover_states: Cards should lift slightly (-translate-y-1) and their border should glow subtly using the accent color. Text within buttons should shift color appropriately.
motion_and_interactions.page_transitions: Framer Motion: fade in and subtle slide up (y: 20 -> y: 0) for route changes.
motion_and_interactions.staggered_lists: Use Framer Motion to stagger the entrance of stat cards and service items.

three_d_scene_blueprint.location: Hero Section (Right side on desktop, subtle background on mobile)

elements.globe: SphereGeometry or IcosahedronGeometry (args=[2, 32, 32]) with wireframe=true, transparent, opacity=0.15, color='#7B7FE8'. Slow constant rotation.
elements.nodes: 3-5 small orbiting spheres (radius=0.04) acting as 'AI nodes'. Emissive material, color='#FFFFFF', emissive='#7B7FE8', emissiveIntensity=2.0. Animate their positions in a circular orbit using useFrame.
elements.lighting: AmbientLight (intensity=0.1), PointLight (color='#7B7FE8', intensity=4.0) placed inside the globe for a central glow.
elements.controls: Optional subtle mouse parallax or use autoRotate=true on the mesh directly.

Home (/).Hero: Asymmetric layout. Left: H1 'Increase Revenue & Cut Costs Up to 50% With Our AI Systems', Tagline: 'We build AI Agents for businesses.', CTA: 'Get Free Automation Audit'. Right: The 3D R3F Canvas.
Home (/).Stats_Bar: Horizontal staggered grid: 50% cost reduction, 24/7 availability, 50+ businesses served, <1hr response.
Home (/).Services_Teaser: Bento grid of 4 services. Cards feature icons (lucide-react), title, short description, and an arrow link.
Home (/).Why_Us: Large typography section highlighting value props: 'Reduce operational costs', 'Capture leads 24/7', 'Respond in seconds'.
Home (/).Footer_CTA: Full width dark panel. 'The Future is Automated. Are You Ready?'

Services (/services).Header: Large typographic header: 'AI solutions that scale your business.'
Services (/services).Listings: Alternating blocks (Left text, Right Image). 1. Google Review Automation (use service_review image), 2. 24/7 AI Voice Agents (use service_voice_agent image), 3. AI Text Agents (use service_text_agent image), 4. Custom Workflow Automation (use service_workflow image).

About (/about).Header: Clean, spacious text layout: 'We're your automation partner.' Subtext: 'Helping you work smarter, serve faster, and grow bigger.'
About (/about).Values_Grid: 3 column layout for values: Result-Driven, Innovation First, Partner Approach.
About (/about).Hero_Image: Use 'about_mission' image inside a wide, rounded-2xl container with a subtle parallax effect.

Contact (/contact).Layout: Two columns. Left: Contact Information (Kabir.shah@akautomations.org, +1 (646) 944-2162). Right: Contact Form.
Contact (/contact).Form: Fields: Name, Email, Phone, Company, Message. Submit button with hover glow.
Contact (/contact).Backend: Submits payload to backend API which saves to MongoDB.

Admin (/admin).Layout: Dashboard view. Simple top nav, main content area with a Shadcn Table component displaying contact form submissions from MongoDB.
Admin (/admin).Styling: Strict 'Control Room' grid. Pure functional design, pure black background, border-zinc-800.

components.Navigation: Fixed top bar. glassmorphism background (backdrop-blur-xl bg-[#05050A]/70). Left: Ackra Logo. Center: Links (Home, Services, About, Contact). Right: 'Get Audit' CTA button.
components.Footer: Large bottom padding (py-24). Contains logo, quick links, contact email/phone, copyright.
components.Buttons: Primary CTA: bg-[#7B7FE8] text-white hover:bg-[#5D62D9]. Secondary: transparent with 1px border-[#7B7FE8] text-[#7B7FE8] hover:bg-[#7B7FE8]/10.
components.Cards: bg-transparent border border-white/5 hover:border-[#7B7FE8]/40 transition-colors duration-300 rounded-2xl p-8.

testing.data_testid_rules: All interactive and key informational elements MUST include a data-testid attribute in kebab-case. Examples: data-testid='nav-home-link', data-testid='hero-cta-button', data-testid='contact-form-submit'.
